newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Uberlandia airport to build control tower.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Uberlandia airport to build control tower.

text.p: Brazil's Uberlandia airport in Minas Gerais state is set to start construction of a new 300,000 reais ($300,000) control tower, Brazilian airport operator Infraero said.
Infraero and the city of Uberlandia are investing a further 700,000 reais ($700,000) in new equipment. The works are scheduled to take six months, Infraero said.

The investment forms part of a 40 million reais ($40 million) agreement signed last year between Infraero and the city of Uberlandia which also includes plans to extend the landing strip and to construct three new terminals.

The landing strip is to be extended to 2,800 meters from 1,950 meters, the new passenger terminal will cover an area of 3,000 square meters and two new cargo terminals will cover 5,000 square meters each, Infraero said.
Infraero and the city of Uberlandia are sharing the investment costs equally.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
